🛡️ Joltez RPG – Forge Your Legend in a Modular Fantasy World
Step into a world where survival meets story, and every journey tells its own tale. Joltez RPG is a lightweight yet feature-rich modpack built for adventurers, explorers, and warriors alike. Designed with roleplaying and immersion at its core, it invites you to experience Minecraft as a true RPG.

🌍 What You’ll Be Doing
🧭 Explore a Living World
Venture through biomes and uncover secrets with the help of your Explorer’s Compass. Ruins, dungeons, and strange artifacts from another world (like Minecraft Dungeons) are scattered across the landscape, waiting to be claimed.

⚔️ Fight with Purpose
Combat isn’t just about clicking anymore. With RPG-style gear systems, enchantments like Soulbound, and visible armor durability, each battle becomes a tactical encounter. Customize your loadout and prepare for anything—from bandit camps to hellish portal spreads.

🎒 Gear Up and Go Further
Carry everything you need in your trusty Backpack. Use magical tools like the Portable Hole for extra space on the go. With mods like Detail Armor Bar and Not Enough Animations, you’ll feel more connected to your equipment than ever before.

📜 Progress Through Adventure
Thanks to Linear Progression and quality-of-life tweaks, your advancement follows a natural, rewarding path. Unlock new gear, discover new places, and push yourself to master the world around you.

🧙 Play Your Way
Although still in active development, Joltez RPG is laying the foundation for a full-blown RPG experience—complete with future class systems, quests, and perhaps even a dedicated multiplayer server. Want to play solo? Everything works right out of the box. Want to invite friends? It’s fully server-compatible.

Whether you're an aspiring mage, a dungeon delver, or just a farmer with a sword, Joltez RPG invites you to become part of a world that remembers your actions.
